info.name: Webex Admin Address Book Features: Single Number Reach API
Get Single Number Reach Primary Available Phone Numbers

params.name: locationId
params.description: Return the list of phone numbers for this location within the given organization. The maximum length is 36.

params.name: max
params.description: Limit the number of phone numbers returned to this maximum count. The default is 2000.

params.name: start
params.description: Start at the zero-based offset in the list of matching phone numbers. The default is 0.

params.name: phoneNumber
params.description: Filter phone numbers based on the comma-separated list provided in the `phoneNumber` array.

items.docs:
List the service and standard PSTN numbers that are available to be assigned as the single number reach's primary phone number.
These numbers are associated with the location specified in the request URL, can be active or inactive, and are unassigned.

The available numbers APIs help identify candidate numbers and their owning entities to simplify the assignment or association of these numbers to members or features.

Retrieving this list requires a full, read-only or location administrator auth

info.name: Create Single Number Reach For a Person

items.docs:
Create a single number reach for a person in an organization.

Single number reach allows you to setup your work calls ring any phone number. This means that your office phone, mobile phone, or any other designated devices can ring at the same time, ensuring you don't miss important calls.

Creating a single number reach for a person requires a full administrator or location administrator auth token with a scope of `spark-admin:telephony_config_write`.
